title: Figure 43: real acoustic pressure contours at 5000 Hz, radiating sphere EPW=25
description: ANSYS 12.1 nodal-solution contour plot of the real component of pressure (Pa) for 5,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water. Tight concentric rings near the source corner of the quarter-circle domain; legend -2531 to 6112 Pa. Higher-frequency case of the BAASS radiating-sphere acoustic simulation.
